outcome: intubation prior to continuous positive airway pressure ventilation
cohort: 26,515 very low birth weight infants born in California from 2010 to 2016
finding: Weekend delivery was associated with an increased need for chest compressions and lower 5-minute Apgar scores in very low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: In this study of very low birth weight infants, weekend delivery was associated with an increased need for chest compressions in the delivery room.
